summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all five paragraphs of the selected Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the conditional hearing and repentance, promised rejoicing, completed revelations, negative prediction and rebuke, tower–woman–Church identification, imperative invitation to ask, limits on disclosure, heart toward God, prohibition of double-mindedness, and past and future salvation through water. The redistributed English brackets preserve the supplemented constituents while leaving hearing outside them; the notes distinguish editorial supplementation from preserved text. The disclosed witness differences agree with the supplied bounded reports and do not displace the working reading. Contextual repentance and the distinction between Lord and Master are compatible with current policy; no doulos rendering occurs here. Acceptance concerns the supplied texts and disclosures only, not authentication of unseen images, exhaustive collation, unique interpretation, or scholarly certification.
